title: fix(enter): restore Models, Agents and MCP catalog tabs
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Restores the Models, Agents, and MCP tabs on the catalog page so all three catalogs are reachable before the drawer redesign ships.
- Keeps the tabs count-free and reuses the existing category URLs and per-catalog search state.
- Contains only the navigation fix extracted from #15271; the auth, key, model-management, and drawer redesigns remain separate.
- Validation: scoped Biome and diff checks pass. The same tab implementation passed Enter typecheck/build on #15271; CI validates this main-based branch independently.

gist.headline: The catalog grew its tabs back
gist.blurb: The catalog’s Models, Agents, and MCP signposts are back where they belong. Three little tabs, saving everyone from an unnecessary scavenger hunt.
gist.summary: Restored the Models, Agents, and MCP navigation tabs on the Enter catalog page, reusing the existing category URLs and separate search state for each catalog.
gist.impact: Users can once again reach all three catalogs directly and keep their search context while switching between Models, Agents, and MCP.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy library-like catalog desk with three clearly labeled pixel tab signposts—Models, Agents, and MCP—growing from small flower pots. Polli, wearing a tiny librarian hat, gently points visitors toward the restored paths while a CRT monitor robot happily indexes cards beside vines and code-plants.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush and light blue wings, wearing a tiny librarian hat as she restores three chunky catalog tabs labeled “MODELS”, “AGENTS”, and “MCP” above a retro terminal; a cheerful CRT monitor robot organizes glowing index cards among code-plants and flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, dark purple (#110518) pixel text, nostalgic but beautiful.
